## Description

Maintains a trailing stop at a multiple of ATR below the highest high for longs (above the lowest low for shorts).

## Where it may fit

Strong trends where a wide, volatility-aware exit can let winners run.

## Vehicles

Equity ETFs, equities, futures, FX, crypto trend systems.

## Required data

OHLC bars, rolling highest high/lowest low, ATR; trade state and position direction.

## Caveats

Primarily an exit/risk rule, not a standalone entry signal; gap risk can exceed the stop price.
